summary: Implementation fully matches the plan. Four DNS-resolution markers added to _TRANSIENT_GITHUB_ERROR_MARKERS in constants.py; regression test test_dns_base_fetch_errors_classified_transient covers all 4 DNS-transient cases and both non-transient non-regression cases; classifier correctly returns True for DNS errors and False for 'could not resolve to a repository/node'; no overlap between transient and non-transient marker sets; no new retry path or budget changes; surgical change only to the marker set and test file.
